title: Design System: Budget Tracker
note: Sidecar written beside DESIGN.md rather than at .impeccable/design.json, because .impeccable/ in this repo is root-owned and unwritable.

negative.contrast: 4.85:1 light on bg, 5.03:1 on its own wash / 6.38:1 dark

category-none.purpose: Rows whose category was deleted, and the collapsed Other ring slice.

display.purpose: The balance, and one figure per page. Manrope 800, tabular, -0.035em. Never used for prose.

headline.purpose: Page title in the sticky header.

figure.purpose: Every money value. tabular-nums lining-nums at -0.02em, so digits never reflow as amounts change.

shadows.name: card-hairline-light
shadows.purpose: Light theme only. White cards on a white page need separation; dark theme separates by fill alone and must not get this.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Overflow menus that float above a row.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Toast slips above the tab bar.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The only easing in the system. No overshoot anywhere.

motion.name: drop
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: a new row landing on the stack.

motion.name: sheet-up
motion.purpose: Entry sheet arriving from the bottom edge on a phone.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour and opacity transitions on hover and press.

categoryPalette.purpose: Colour is identity in this system. These fourteen are used flat and at full strength in avatars, ring slices and budget fills, never tinted. They never appear in the semantic layer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per surface. Pill, flat accent fill, presses in.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Everything that is not the one action. Fill from the surface ramp, never a border.

components.name: Quick Action
components.description: Circular verb under the balance: filled disc, label beneath. The accent variant is the primary add.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Filled and borderless until focus. Radius 14px, never a rule.

narrative.overview:
A consumer banking app, not a document. It behaves like the thing people already have in their pocket: a balance that leads at display scale, a stack of tappable rows underneath it, circular category avatars doing the recognition work, and every surface a flat rounded card floating on a near-black or pure-white ground. Nothing is ruled, framed, or tabulated.

The density is generous and thumb-first. Cards are 20px-rounded and separated by air, not by lines. Rows are 44px-plus. Controls are pills. Entry arrives from the bottom edge on a phone and from the centre on a desktop. Weight, not case or rule, makes hierarchy: Manrope runs 400 through 800 and the heavy end is reserved for money.

The world is pinned to Revolut and played straight, with one deliberate departure: no gradients anywhere, including where the reference uses them. Depth is done entirely with surface tone and radius.
keyCharacteristics: Flat rounded cards as the only container; zero gradients, verified live
A display-scale balance in Manrope 800 with tight negative tracking
Circular category avatars in flat, full-strength category colour
Pill controls; the selected segment fills with the foreground ink
Colour means exactly three things: identity, money in, trouble
One navigation at every width — sidebar from lg, tab bar below it
One authored motion moment: a new row dropping onto the stack

rules.name: No Gradient, Ever
rules.body: No gradient on any background, button, chart fill or fade mask — including where the pinned reference uses one. Depth comes from stepping the surface ramp and from radius. Verified live: zero elements with any background-image.

rules.name: Colour Means Three Things
rules.body: Category colour is identity, green is money arriving, red is trouble. Ordinary spending is never red — the minus sign carries direction. A fourth meaning would make all four unreadable.

rules.name: Weight, Not Case
rules.body: Hierarchy is made with Manrope's 400-800 range. No uppercase letter-spaced micro-labels, no second typeface, no monospace.

rules.name: Money Is Tabular
rules.body: Every money value runs through .figure: tabular-nums lining-nums at -0.02em, so digits never reflow as amounts change.

rules.name: Air, Not Rules
rules.body: Surfaces separate by fill and space. The only 1px lines in the system are the tab bar's top edge and the light-theme card hairline, which exists solely because white cards on a white page need an edge.

rules.name: Forty-Four
rules.body: Every thumb target gets a 44px hit area through the invisible .tap helper, never by inflating the visual control.

rules.name: Say It In Words
rules.body: Status is stated in language as well as colour — '€40 over', '38% of the month gone'. Nothing is carried by colour alone.

rules.name: Category Colour Is Identity Only
rules.body: The fourteen category colours are used flat and at full strength for identity. A budget bar carries its category colour while on track and switches to caution or negative when the verdict changes — the swap is the signal.

dos: Do put every new container in a flat 20px card on the surface ramp, with no border in dark and the 6% hairline in light.
Do run every money value through the tabular .figure treatment, and set it at weight 800.
Do let the minus sign carry direction on an expense, and reserve green for money arriving.
Do give a category its own colour at full strength in avatars, ring slices and budget fills — flat, never tinted.
Do give every thumb target a 44px hit area with the invisible tap helper rather than by growing the control.
Do state status in words as well as colour, never in colour alone.
Do keep exactly one navigation visible at every width.
Do open entry as a bottom sheet below sm and a centred dialog above it, from the one Modal component.
donts: Don't use a gradient anywhere — background, button, chart fill, or fade mask. This holds even where the pinned reference uses one.
Don't add a shadow to make something read as raised; step the surface tone instead.
Don't colour ordinary spending red. Red means trouble: errors, destructive actions, over-budget.
Don't introduce a second typeface, a monospace, or uppercase letter-spaced micro-labels.
Don't ship a square corner; the floor is 12px.
Don't rule the interface — no hairline dividers as structure, no column tables, no bordered inputs.
Don't reveal an action only on hover; a touch device has no hover to reveal it with.
Don't draw a partial month's bar the same as a complete one, or let a clamped percentage stand in for the true figure in assistive text.
Don't add a second signature animation. There is one drop, and it belongs to a new row landing.
knownGaps: The entry sheet's amount field is an ordinary text input; the reference's signature keypad-style entry is not built.
Rows have hover states but no :active press feedback, on a surface whose premise is tappable rows.
Desktop is largely a widened phone layout; only the balance card has a genuinely desktop composition.
